Action: Bathymetric and beach profile survey of all four mouths; record of how each mouth behaved in the monsoon
Repair of training walls and groynes; sand bypassing; removal of debris and solid waste from estuaries
Monthly monitoring of mouth width and depth; maintenance dredging where triggers are crossed
All four mouths open to design section; joint inspection with GCC and District Collectors
Daily watch on the mouths; tide and surge forecasts linked to CRTFFS; emergency pilot channels cut with standby machinery when a mouth narrows during a storm
